text:
You need a natural, budget-conscious local link-building plan to help haratscrapcar.ca move keywords like “scrap car removal in Richmond,” “Burnaby,” and “Vancouver” beyond positions 10–20.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboards, and data visualization with SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. While my background is analytics, I’m very comfortable using data to guide outreach and measure what actually moves rankings.

In Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I built a model in BigQuery and Looker Studio to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit, which led to 18% of ad budget being reallocated and CAC down 12% the next quarter. In Subscription churn cohorts, I built cohort retention curves and an onboarding funnel; one step was linked to 40% of first-month churn.

I’d approach this with a simple plan: prioritize the most relevant local citations, niche-relevant outreach, and track link quality and ranking changes. Which cities or pages are your top priority to start with?
